name: Gridlens
tagline: Open a CSV and get answers, without uploading anything
description: For analysts, founders and anyone handed a CSV they cannot send to a third-party service. It profiles, filters, pivots and charts the file entirely inside the browser, with no spreadsheet and no upload.
features: RFC 4180 CSV parser with BOM handling and comma, semicolon and tab detection, run in a Web Worker with a main-thread fallback
Virtualised table that scrolls 100,000 rows, with column sort, resize and hide
Per-column profile with nulls, unique count, min, max, mean, median and a histogram or top values
Pivot with sum, average, count, min and max, plus AND filter conditions by type and text search
Bar, line, scatter and histogram charts drawn on canvas with axes, tooltips and PNG export
Computed columns in a small formula language, and saved views that persist in the browser
engineering: Computed columns are tokenized, parsed and type-checked by a hand-written Pratt parser and compiled to closures over column arrays, so formulas can never reach eval, Function or any JavaScript object.
